0.text: I want to book Thursday at 7pm

hero.title: Every message you don't answer is an ad you paid for.
hero.subtitle: Mudrik answers your customers in a second — on WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram and your site — using your own information, books their appointments, and records every lead in one place.
hero.cta_secondary: We'll set it up for you

problem.title: The problem isn't that you don't answer. It's that you can't see what you lost.

items.label: The messages come at night
items.body: A customer asks at 11pm and the answer comes in the morning. By then they've usually gone somewhere else.

items.label: Everyone answers differently
items.body: The price is right once and wrong the next time. What one person knows, the next one doesn't.

items.label: Leads get lost in the inbox
items.body: Nobody knows how many asked today, who got booked, or who was forgotten.

how.title: Three steps and Mudrik is working

steps.label: Tell it about your business
steps.body: Your hours, branches, services, prices. Write them once, or we'll write them for you.

steps.label: Connect your channels
steps.body: WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, and a widget on your site. The same bot across all four.

steps.label: Let it answer
steps.body: It answers from your information, not from its own head, books appointments, and leaves you every conversation to read.

features.title: Not a chatbot that answers in generalities

items.label: It knows your business
items.body: Every answer comes from the information you entered. It doesn't invent, and when it doesn't know, it says so.

items.label: It books appointments
items.body: It knows each branch's hours, and won't book on a closed day or outside working hours.

items.label: It captures every lead
items.body: Name, number, service and appointment, in one list you can follow and export.

items.label: It speaks to your customers in their own dialect
items.body: Not a translation. It understands your customers' Egyptian as they write it, answers in it, and reads a phone number however it's typed.

try.title: The bot in that corner is Mudrik.
try.body: Not a video, not screenshots. Ask it about pricing, the plans, or how it works, and see for yourself.

paths.title: Set it up yourself, or have us do it?

self.label: Set it up yourself
self.body: Sign up, enter your information, connect your channels. Right if you have the time, or if you manage more than one account.

done_for_you.label: We set it up for you
done_for_you.body: We write the knowledge base, configure the settings, and test it on real conversations until it answers the way you want. A one-time setup fee.

paths.agencies_link: Managing accounts for clients? There's a page for you.

pricing.title: Plans that match your size
pricing.body: The plans differ in channels, conversations and branches. We talk about price based on your size.

closing.title: See it with your real customers
closing.body: Enter your information, connect a channel, and watch the bot answer your real customers.

hero.title: Your business answers for itself, even while you sleep
hero.body: Mudrik knows your hours, services, prices and branches, and answers everyone who asks — on WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram and your site.

day.title: An ordinary day with Mudrik
items: 8am — someone asked about prices last night. The answer was waiting for them.
Midday — three people booked without anyone answering by hand.
At night — someone asked something unusual. Mudrik didn't invent an answer; it said the team would get back to them, and passed it to you.
End of day — everyone who asked is in one list, with their names, numbers and what they wanted.

whatYouGive.title: What you enter once
whatYouGive.body: Working hours, branches, services, prices, and the questions you get over and over. Write them in plain language; there's no format to learn.
whatYouGive.note: No time? We'll write them, configure them and test them, for a one-time setup fee.

limits.title: What Mudrik doesn't do
limits.body: It doesn't invent. If the information isn't in what you gave it, it says the team will follow up rather than making something up. And it doesn't give professional advice — if a question needs an expert, it hands it over.
limits.note: We say this plainly because it's half the value. A bot that invents is worse than no bot.

closing.title: See it with your real customers
closing.body: Enter your hours and services, connect a channel, and see the difference yourself.

hero.title: A new client every week, without a new hire
hero.body: Run all your clients' accounts from one place. Each client has its own knowledge base, channels and team, and you see all of them from above.

items.label: Leads stop leaking
items.body: You're spending your client's ad budget, and an unanswered message wastes it. Mudrik answers every one in a second.

items.label: A report with numbers in it
items.body: How many asked, how many booked, how many showed up. Numbers for the monthly report instead of estimates.

items.label: Nothing new to learn per client
items.body: The same dashboard for every client. Whoever set up one can set up the next.

honest.title: Something we'll say upfront
honest.body: Mudrik currently runs under its own name, not your agency's. If that matters to you, talk to us and tell us exactly what you need — we build what clients ask for.

closing.title: Start with one client
closing.body: Set it up on one account first. If it works, add more.

hero.title: Plans that match your size
hero.body: The plans differ in channels, branches, conversations and accounts. We talk about price based on your size, so someone with one branch doesn't pay like someone with ten.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.body: Right if you're starting out, or testing one channel before you expand.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.for: More than one branch, every channel
tiers.body: WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram and your site together, with different hours and capacity per branch.

tiers.name: Agency
tiers.for: More than one client under one account
tiers.body: Each client fully separated from the others, and you see all of them.

setup.title: Setup — optional
setup.body: We write the knowledge base, configure the settings and hours, and test the bot on real conversations until it answers the way you want. A one-time fee, separate from the subscription.

next.title: Not sure which plan?
next.body: Tell us how many branches and channels you have and how many messages you get, and we'll tell you which fits and what it costs.

hero.title: Talk to us
hero.body: Whether you want a price, want us to set it up for you, or have a question before you try it — write to us.
